Module overview

Module

Contents

starkzee.line_profile

High-level LineProfile class and DiscreteTransitions

starkzee.static_profile

Static Stark-Zeeman profile solver and discrete-transition enumerator

starkzee.ffm

Frequency Fluctuation Model (dynamic ion broadening)

starkzee.radiator

Basis states, Hamiltonian construction, dipole matrix elements, oscillator strengths, Einstein A coefficients

starkzee.microfield

Holtsmark and Hooper microfield distributions, quadrature grid builder

starkzee.broadening

GBK electron impact broadening with magnetic-field cutoff

starkzee.convolutions

FFT-based Doppler and instrumental broadening (post-processing)

starkzee.utils

Physical constants (via scipy.constants) and unit conversions

starkzee.atomic_data

NIST atomic energy-level database loader; AtomicState dataclass
